name: Kottayam
registryBasis: The official Kerala Survey & Land Records office directory explicitly locates the Deputy Director and District Survey Superintendent at Civil Station Kottayam and the resurvey/mapping offices at Kodimala Junction in Kottayam. These are city-bound survey/land-record institutions; they do not prove accessible vector geometry or citywide completeness.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The public BhuNaksha interface search result exposes administrative and plot selectors, but direct route inspection was blocked by expired TLS validation. Ente Bhoomi HTML exposes a citizen search form; its parcel-specific fields were not submitted. No vector feature schema was found.
scopeLimits: Local Kottayam survey/mapping institutions and state cadastral-map portal are verified. No full georeferenced polygon, feature identifier, or point-level parcel coverage was verified; citizen form requires survey/subdivision identifiers and captcha.
remainingUncertainty: No complete georeferenced polygon or native feature ID was verified at the WUP point; public map viewers may provide display-only or identity-dependent workflows not tested.

executedQueries.query: Kottayam Kerala official cadastral parcel map GIS land survey resurvey public map
executedQueries.scope: Find a city-specific primary registry source and a safe anonymous geometry-only route.
executedQueries.result: The official Kerala survey-office directory lists the Deputy Director, Assistant Director (Re-Survey), Assistant Director (Mapping), District Survey Superintendent, and District Digitization Centre in Kottayam. The state BhuNaksha portal advertises parcel/map selectors and Plot Info, but its direct HTTPS request failed certificate validation (expired certificate); no bypass was attempted. The public Ente Bhoomi survey search page asks for a survey number, subdivision number, and captcha; no parcel fields were submitted. No safe anonymous full-polygon schema/endpoint was verified.
executedQueries.executionMethod: English-language web search plus direct anonymous inspection of official public routes.
